AGRI ORGANIC CULTIVATION COMPANY

Grow Organic Food. Grow Together.

AOCC aims to build a farmer-partnership model where cultivation operations can be supported and managed by the company from planning to harvest and market connection.

Partner With AOCC

Organic Cultivation

Promote responsible cultivation practices focused on quality produce and healthier soil.

Farmer Partnership

Create a structured partnership between farmers and AOCC with clear responsibilities and terms.

Market Support

Build systems for crop planning, harvesting, marketing and connecting produce with buyers.

10% Farmer Commission

Under the proposed AOCC model, eligible participating farmers may receive a 10% commission according to the final agreement and business terms.

What AOCC Can Handle

A single coordinated cultivation workflow.

01. Planning

Crop selection, cultivation planning and scheduling.

02. Cultivation

Support for land preparation, seeds, organic inputs, irrigation and crop care.

03. Harvest

Harvest planning, quality checks and post-harvest handling.

04. Marketing

Develop buyer connections and marketing channels for the produce.

05. Records

Maintain cultivation and partnership records for transparent operations.

06. Growth

Scale the model carefully as farmer partnerships and demand increase.

How It Works

A simple starting process for farmer partnerships.

Farmer applies

Submit basic land and contact information.

AOCC reviews

Discuss land, crop, location and partnership requirements.

Plan is agreed

Finalize responsibilities, costs, commission and terms in writing.

Cultivation begins

Start the agreed cultivation and monitoring process.

Harvest & market

Coordinate harvesting and sales according to the agreed plan.

Settlement

Complete transparent accounting and farmer payment according to the agreement.
